units.source_text: 西厅里的玉鬘慑于风威，一夜不曾合眼。

en.t: In the west wing, Tamakazura was so frightened by the force of the wind that she had not closed her eyes all night.

units.source_text: 因此早上起得迟了，此时还在对镜理妆。

en.t: Because of that, she had risen late in the morning and was still arranging her makeup before the mirror.

units.source_text: 源氏吩咐前驱人不要大声喝道，悄悄地走进玉鬘房中。

en.t: Genji told his attendants not to announce him loudly, and quietly entered Tamakazura's room.

units.source_text: 屏风等都已折叠起来，四周什物零乱。

en.t: The screens and other furnishings had all been folded away, and things lay in disorder all around.

units.source_text: 日光明亮地射进室内，照得玉鬘的芳姿更加清楚了。

en.t: Bright sunlight streamed into the room, making Tamakazura's lovely figure appear even more clearly.

units.source_text: 源氏偎傍着她坐下来，以慰问风灾为借口，照例叨叨絮絮对她说了许多情话。

en.t: Genji sat down close beside her and, using concern over the storm damage as a pretext, spoke many rambling words of love to her as usual.

units.source_text: 玉鬘讨厌不堪，恨恨地说道：“你老是讲这些难听的话，

en.t: Tamakazura, unable to bear her disgust, said resentfully, "You are always saying such unpleasant things,

units.source_text: 我真想教昨夜的风把我吹走，吹得不知去向才好。”

en.t: I truly wish last night's wind had blown me away, somewhere no one would ever know."

units.source_text: 源氏笑容可掬地答道：“教风吹走，太轻飘了。

en.t: Genji answered with a beaming smile, "To be blown away by the wind is far too flighty.

units.source_text: 你被吹去，总有个着落的地方吧。

en.t: Even if you were blown away, you would surely land somewhere in the end.

units.source_text: 可知你渐渐有了离开我的心思了。

en.t: So it seems you have gradually begun to think of leaving me.

units.source_text: 这也是理之当然。”

en.t: That too is only natural."

units.source_text: 玉鬘听了这话，觉得自己想到便说，未免太直率了，也就莞尔而笑，那笑容异常艳丽。

en.t: Hearing this, Tamakazura felt she had spoken too bluntly from impulse, and she gave a faint smile; that smile was extraordinarily charming.

units.source_text: 她的面庞像酸浆果那样丰满。

en.t: Her face was as full and rounded as a winter cherry fruit.

units.source_text: 垂发中间露出来的肤色非常美丽。

en.t: The complexion showing between her falling locks of hair was very beautiful.

units.source_text: 只是眼睛笑的模样反而损害了气品的高雅。

en.t: Only the way her eyes smiled somewhat lessened the elegance of her bearing.

units.source_text: 此外全无一点可非难之处。

en.t: Apart from that, there was not the slightest thing to criticize.

units.source_text: 夕雾在室外，听见源氏与玉鬘谈得很亲昵，很想看一看玉鬘的容颜。

en.t: Yugiri, outside the room, heard Genji and Tamakazura speaking so intimately and badly wanted to see her face.

units.source_text: 屋角的帘子里面虽然设着帷屏，但因大风之故，已经歪斜，

en.t: Inside the blinds at the corner of the room a curtain screen had been set up, but because of the gale it was already leaning askew,

units.source_text: 把帘子略微揭开些，里面没有遮蔽，可以很清楚地窥见玉鬘之姿色。

en.t: and when the blind was lifted a little, there was nothing to block the view inside, so Tamakazura's beauty could be seen very clearly.

units.source_text: 他看见父亲分明是在调戏这姐姐，想道：“虽然是父亲，

en.t: Seeing that his father was plainly flirting with this elder sister, he thought, "Even if he is her father,

units.source_text: 但姐姐已经不是可以抱在怀里的婴儿了！”

en.t: my sister is no longer an infant who can be held in one's arms!"

units.source_text: 便注目细看。

en.t: So he fixed his eyes on them and looked closely.

units.source_text: 他深恐被父亲察觉，拟即退去。

en.t: He was deeply afraid his father would notice him and meant to withdraw at once.

units.source_text: 但这景象太奇怪了，使他不肯不看。

en.t: But the scene was so strange that he could not bring himself to stop looking.

units.source_text: 但见玉鬘坐在柱旁，面孔略微转向一旁。

en.t: He saw Tamakazura sitting beside a pillar, her face turned slightly to one side.

units.source_text: 源氏把她拉过来，她的头发便披向一边，波浪一般荡动，甚是美观。

en.t: When Genji drew her toward him, her hair fell to one side and swayed like waves, a very beautiful sight.

units.source_text: 她脸上显出嫌恶痛苦之色，然而并不坚拒，终于和颜悦色地靠近父亲身边。

en.t: Her face showed aversion and distress, yet she did not firmly resist, and in the end she moved close to her father with a gentle expression.

units.source_text: 可见是向来习惯如此的。

en.t: It was clear that she had long been accustomed to this.

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“啊呀呀，太不成样了！

en.t: Yugiri thought, "Oh, this is disgraceful!

units.source_text: 这是怎么一回事啊？

en.t: What on earth is going on here?

units.source_text: 父亲在色情上无孔不入，因此对于这个不在身边长大的女儿，也会起这种念头。

en.t: My father lets desire enter everywhere, so even toward this daughter who did not grow up at his side, he can have such thoughts.

units.source_text: 怪不得这样亲密。

en.t: No wonder they are so intimate.

units.source_text: 可是，啊呀！

en.t: But, ah!

units.source_text: 成个什么样子呢！”

en.t: What sort of thing can this become!"

units.source_text: 他觉得自己这样想也很可耻。

en.t: He felt that even thinking such thoughts himself was deeply shameful.

units.source_text: 他又想：“这女子相貌真漂亮！

en.t: Then he thought again, "This woman is truly beautiful!

units.source_text: 我和她虽说是姐弟，然而并非同胞，血缘较远，我对她也不免发生恋情。”

en.t: Though she and I are called sister and brother, we are not born of the same mother, and our blood tie is distant; I cannot help falling in love with her too."

units.source_text: 他觉得此人比较起昨日窥见的那人来，自然略逊一筹。

en.t: He felt that compared with the woman he had glimpsed yesterday, this one was naturally somewhat inferior.

units.source_text: 然而令人一见便觉可爱，则又不妨说是并驾齐驱。

en.t: Yet in making one feel affection at first sight, she could well be said to stand beside her as an equal.

units.source_text: 他忽然想起：此人的姿色好比盛开的重瓣棣棠花，带着露水，映着夕阳。

en.t: It suddenly occurred to him that her beauty was like a fully blooming double-petaled kerria, wet with dew and glowing in the evening sun.

units.source_text: 用春花来比喻，虽然与这季节不符，但总有这样的感想。

en.t: Although comparing her to a spring flower did not suit the season, that was the feeling that kept coming to him.

units.source_text: 花的美色有限，有时还交混着不美的花蕊。

en.t: The beauty of flowers has its limits, and sometimes unbeautiful stamens are mixed in among them.

units.source_text: 而人的容颜，其美实在是无物可以比拟的。

en.t: But the beauty of a human face truly cannot be compared with anything else.
